issues.basis: NL3 requires PumpControl to initially enter PumpState. The exact closed model instead contains three owner-local initial transitions to synthetic invalid targets, while PumpState is a separate top-level state. The complete owned transition inventory therefore shows a scoped owner-local target mismatch.
issues.expected: The PumpControl-owned initial entry must target PumpState within the PumpControl scope.
